AI001.title: Untrusted input observed flowing into prompt construction
AI001.remediation: Move untrusted content into a delimited user-role message and keep instruction text static.

crosswalk.so_what: Untrusted input can reach the model's instruction text.

AI002.title: Model output observed reaching a dangerous execution or injection sink
AI002.remediation: Dispatch through a static mapping of permitted actions; never execute or render model output directly.

crosswalk.so_what: Model output is executed or rendered without an interposed validation step.

AI003.title: Approval control not observed for high-impact tool capability
AI003.remediation: Confirm an approval or human-in-the-loop control gates this capability; none was observed in this file.

crosswalk.so_what: A high-impact action can fire with no human-approval step observed.

AI004.title: Identifier suggesting sensitive data observed in an external model call
AI004.remediation: Pseudonymize sensitive fields before the model call and rejoin identifiers afterward.

crosswalk.so_what: Sensitive identifiers are placed into prompts that leave the trust boundary.

AI005.title: Model, endpoint, or artifact dependency observed without a pin or integrity control
AI005.remediation: Pin a reviewed model revision or dated snapshot and use a TLS endpoint from an allowlist.

crosswalk.so_what: The model reference is unpinned, so behavior can change under you silently.

AI006.title: Identifier suggesting sensitive data observed flowing to a network egress sink
AI006.remediation: Strip sensitive fields before egress, or add the destination to [rules.AI006].allowed_hosts if org-approved.

crosswalk.so_what: A path exists for data to leave over the network to an unapproved destination.

AI007.title: Deterministic sampling not observed on high-impact-adjacent call sites
AI007.remediation: Pin deterministic sampling (temperature=0) on consequential model call sites, or confirm variability is intended.

crosswalk.so_what: No sampling bound was observed — output stability is a proxy signal only.

AI008.title: Non-idempotent money action under retry
AI008.remediation: Send an idempotency key derived from a stable identifier (the dispute or order id), disable retries on money tools, and check limits per dispute rather than per call.

crosswalk.so_what: A retried money action with no idempotency key can post twice, and each attempt stays under the per-call limit.

CTRL001.title: Authentication control not observed
CTRL001.remediation: Confirm authentication is enforced before this agent acts; it was not observed in this file.

crosswalk.so_what: No authentication control was observed on the agent's actions.

CTRL002.title: Input validation control not observed
CTRL002.remediation: Confirm inputs are validated before this agent acts; validation was not observed in this file.

crosswalk.so_what: No input-validation control was observed before the agent acts on input.

CTRL003.title: Rate limiting control not observed
CTRL003.remediation: Confirm rate limiting exists for this agent's actions; it was not observed in this file.

crosswalk.so_what: No rate limit was observed, so repeated calls can run up cost or load.

CTRL004.title: Observability construct not observed for agent tool execution
CTRL004.remediation: Confirm logging or tracing covers this agent's tool execution; none was observed in this file.

crosswalk.so_what: Without logging you cannot reconstruct what the agent did.

CTRL005.title: Rate limiting not observed on a high-impact-capability loop
CTRL005.remediation: Confirm this loop is rate-limited or bounded; no limiter or backoff construct was observed within it.

crosswalk.so_what: No cap on loop iterations was observed — runaway cost or denial-of-service exposure.

CTRL006.title: Sandboxing not observed on an exec path
CTRL006.remediation: Confirm this execution path runs in a restricted environment (restricted env, container, sandboxed interpreter); none was observed near it.

crosswalk.so_what: An execution path was not observed to be sandboxed — a large blast radius.

CTRL007.title: No kill-switch signal observed on the agent's entry path
CTRL007.remediation: Consider a feature-flag or env-var gate that can disable this agent without a deploy; none was observed. This is the weakest signal in the control set -- informational only.

crosswalk.so_what: No kill-switch signal was observed to halt the agent mid-run.

DECL001.title: Declared autonomy contradicts inferred autonomy
DECL001.remediation: This agent was declared recommend-only or human-approved, but the scanner found a side-effecting path with no correlated approval gate. Either add the missing approval control, or correct the declaration.

crosswalk.so_what: Declared autonomy does not match what the code does.

DECL002.title: Declared economic authority has no enforcement observed
DECL002.remediation: An economic limit was declared for this agent's money-moving path, but no cap check or rate limiter was observed enforcing it in code.

crosswalk.so_what: A claimed enforcement control is not present in the code.

DECL003.title: Money-moving or contract-signing permission with no declared economic authority
DECL003.remediation: This agent can move funds, approve transactions, or sign contracts, but stoa-declared.toml has no economic_authority for it. Declare a limit.

crosswalk.so_what: The agent can move value but no economic authority was declared.

DECL004.title: Scanned data class not present in declared data classes
DECL004.remediation: The scanner found evidence of a data class this agent touches that isn't in its declared data_classes. Update the declaration or confirm the finding is a false positive.

crosswalk.so_what: The agent handles a data category that was not declared.

DECL005.title: Production agent has no observability observed
DECL005.remediation: This agent is declared production_status = "production", but no observability construct was observed (CTRL004). Add logging or tracing before relying on this in production.

crosswalk.so_what: The agent runs in production with no observability observed.

DECL006.title: Scanned agent has no declaration entry
DECL006.remediation: stoa-declared.toml exists but doesn't mention this agent. Add an [agents."<id>"] entry, even a partial one.

crosswalk.so_what: The agent is not declared at all.

DECL007.title: Declaration references an agent id no longer produced by the scanner
DECL007.remediation: This declared agent id no longer matches any scanned agent -- the code may have moved or been removed. Update or delete the stale declaration.

crosswalk.so_what: A declaration no longer matches the code it describes.
A non-local endpoint is reached over plaintext HTTP.

NET002.title: Request timeout not observed
NET002.remediation: Pass an explicit timeout so a hung upstream cannot stall the agent.

crosswalk.so_what: A network call has no timeout, so a hung dependency can stall the agent.

REL001.title: Swallowed exception
REL001.remediation: Handle or log the exception instead of silently discarding it.

crosswalk.so_what: An exception is swallowed, so a failure can pass unnoticed.

RT001.title: Declared human oversight not observed at runtime
RT001.remediation: This agent is declared recommend-only or human-approved, but traces show high-impact actions executing with no approval span. Either the approval control is not wired into the live path, or the declaration is wrong. Fix the gate or correct the declaration.

crosswalk.so_what: At runtime the declared oversight step was not observed to fire.

RT002.title: Observed monetary action exceeds declared economic authority
RT002.remediation: A traced action moved more money than stoa-declared.toml allows (max_per_action, or the window total vs daily_aggregate). Enforce the declared limit in code, or raise the declared authority through review.

crosswalk.so_what: The agent acted beyond the declared money or authority limit.

RT003.title: Observed capability absent from both registry and declarations
RT003.remediation: Traces show this agent exercising a capability the static scan never found and no declaration covers — its real reach exceeds everything on paper. Locate the code path (it may be in an unscanned dependency or service) and bring it under scan or declaration.

crosswalk.so_what: Observed runtime reach exceeded the declared scope.

RT004.title: Monitoring declared for a production agent, but no traces observed
RT004.remediation: This agent is declared production with monitoring evidence, yet the analyzed trace window contains no spans for it. Observability is claimed but not evidenced — instrument the agent or correct the declaration.

crosswalk.so_what: Monitoring was declared, but runtime shows no evidence of it.

RT005.title: Approval gate observed firing on all high-impact actions
RT005.remediation: No action needed — static inference says human_approved and traces confirm approval spans on 100% of high-impact actions in the window. Reported as observed good news, consistent with control-credit language.

crosswalk.so_what: An approval gate was observed firing on high-impact actions in the window.

SEC001.title: Possible hardcoded API credential
SEC001.remediation: Load the credential from a secret manager or environment variable.

crosswalk.so_what: A credential is embedded in source where anyone with repo access can read it.

SEC002.title: Possible hardcoded password
SEC002.remediation: Load the password from a secret manager or environment variable.

crosswalk.so_what: A password is embedded in source rather than held in a secret store.

SEC003.title: Interpolated SQL statement
SEC003.remediation: Use parameterized queries instead of string interpolation.

crosswalk.so_what: Untrusted values are interpolated into a SQL statement instead of parameterized.

dimensions.name: Mandate overreach
dimensions.definition: Agent reach exceeding its declared operating scope

dimensions.name: Boundary leakage
dimensions.definition: Sensitive data leaving the trust boundary via model calls or network egress

dimensions.name: Unreviewed high-impact action
dimensions.definition: High-impact actions reachable without an observed authorization or approval control

dimensions.name: Output fidelity
dimensions.definition: Incorrect or unsafe model output causing downstream harm; correctness itself is a runtime property

dimensions.name: Injection & tamper surface
dimensions.definition: Susceptibility surface for prompt injection, poisoning, or supply-chain tampering

dimensions.name: Dependency drift
dimensions.definition: Model behavior changing over time (upstream swaps, performance decay)

dimensions.name: Control coverage gap
dimensions.definition: Absence of observed operating controls: auth, validation, rate limits, observability

nist_ai_rmf.stoa: The agent inventory and the dimension matrix establish context: what agents exist and where their exposure sits.
The findings and their file:line evidence, with OWASP and EU AI Act anchors, quantify and characterize that exposure.
stoa diff gating and the assurance export carry that evidence into change control and external review.
An organizational function outside a static scan's view; not assessed.
